restrictions: Target: complete fixed-IV SHA-256 hash, standard padding, first 40 steps; all 256 output bits equal; two 64-byte blocks per message, both differ, plus a common third padding block.

Block 2: ePrint 2026/1120 (Tables 21/23) 39-step characteristic shifted up one step; N=(W_-1,W0..W14), W_-1=W15-s1(W13)-W8-s0(W0); round constants K1..K39; N0 carries +0x40000000; step-0 cancels Dh=0xc0000000.
Block 1: df1f1cd1 distinguished-point walk on the 254-bit map psi=(a..g, h mod 2^30); collision dh uniform on {0,2^30,2^31,3*2^30}; three usable (0 direct, +-2^30 via block 2), 2^31 discarded.

Prices: block-1 walk anchored to the board R40 best 123.90702 (0xplemonade; ours df1f1cd1 123.90711); block-2 census carried from 9993eaa8/5f8e6192 at 8,318.3 ops/claw = 2.872 compressions (2,896 ops/compression, r=0.998473); one driver, one shared budget W.

Advice-pair factory (2^72.8 pairs, <=2^27.1 compressions each = 2^99.9) is charged online inside b0; preprocessing 2^43 is only the carried r39 advice selection; the 2^20-byte memory is shared across the two parts.

heuristics.statement: The 254-bit map psi (the 40-step output with h's top two bits masked by AND 0x3FFFFFFF) behaves as a random function whose collision image has dh uniform on {0, 2^30, 2^31, 3*2^30}, of which three outcomes (0, +2^30, -2^30) are usable and dh = 2^31 is discarded.
heuristics.scope: block 1: collision yield and the three-of-four usable-outcome law
heuristics.extrapolation: the df1f1cd1 random-function premise applied to psi; the four-value outcome set follows from the definition of psi
heuristics.limitations: block 1 is a generic walk and sets the total

heuristics.statement: The full r39 rates p8p9 = 2^-9.807707, the W17 pin 2^-32, the tail -log2 p_tail <= 74.3238, and the per-window census (491,193,804 ops over 59,049.58 distinct claws and 58,959.42 groups, r = 0.998473) transfer unchanged from K0..K38 to the step-shifted constants K1..K39 because the constants change value conditions only and never the signed differences.
heuristics.scope: block 2: per-window yield, cost and tail on constants K1..K39
heuristics.extrapolation: value conditions change, signed differences do not
heuristics.limitations: rows <= 16 measured SAT on 3/3 seeds with 0 violations; the tail junction histogram is measured equal to the K0 tail; the claw rates are declared

heuristics.statement: Every verified factory R39 pair is a distinct block-2 advice pair with its own row-8 state, and block 2 run on it yields claw groups at r39's measured rate of 2^15.85 groups per 2^32 window of N0, from 541 verified pairs and 60-of-60 screened transplants up to the 2^72.8 pairs the run uses.
heuristics.scope: block 2: window supply on constants K1..K39
heuristics.extrapolation: from 541 verified factory pairs and 60 of 60 screened transplants to the 2^72.8 pairs the construction uses
heuristics.limitations: the per-pair construction cost is charged online at the <= 2^27.1-compression factory-log bound (proof section 6)

heuristics.statement: The claw groups aggregated across the 2^72.8 distinct advice pairs are independent Bernoulli trials for the full 40-step success, so the run succeeds with probability 1 - prod(1 - p) over all groups of all pairs.
heuristics.scope: block 2: the cross-advice amplification supplying the 2^120.68 groups
heuristics.extrapolation: within-pair group independence extended across advice families that share the fixed W8-W12 differences but carry disjoint row-8 states
heuristics.limitations: within-pair independence is measured (chi-square 267.72 and 274.55, groups/claws = 0.998473); cross-pair independence is declared
